findings.title: Deleting cache does not invalidate the `connectedCalendars` query
findings.body: `deleteCacheMutation` does not call `utils.viewer.calendars.connectedCalendars.invalidate()` in `onSettled` or `onSuccess` (unlike `disconnectMutation` right below it on lines 61-64). In `SelectedCalendarsSettingsWebWrapper`, `onChanged` is optional and is not passed by all callers, so after deleting cached data the `connectedCalendars` query remains stale and the dropdown continues to show the old `cacheUpdatedAt` status and "Delete cached data" action until the page is refreshed.

findings.title: `getCacheStatusByCredentialIds` includes expired cache entries
findings.body: `getCacheStatusByCredentialIds` groups `CalendarCache` rows by `credentialId` without filtering by `expiresAt: { gte: new Date() }` (whereas `getCachedAvailability` on lines 112 and 127 only treats entries with `expiresAt >= now` as cached). If a credential only has expired cache rows in the database, the UI will still report an active cache status and offer to delete cached data even though no valid cache is being served.
